name: MIMO-NeRF-self-R2
definition: A variant of MIMO-NeRF using two reformulated MIMO MLPs with reduction factors R1=1 and R2=1.
summary: MIMO-NeRF-self-R2 is a NeRF variant using two reformulated MIMO MLPs to reduce training time via parallel ray processing while maintaining rendering quality comparable to the original NeRF.
